title: Natural tensor comparison of derived pullback on K-flat representatives
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and derived pullback $L=Lg^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $F$ be an additive functor between the categories of sheaves of modules, identified on objects and morphisms with the tensor-formula module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]: supply equalities $h_M:F(M)=g^*M$ and require $F(a)=h_M;g^*(a);h_N^{-1}$. Let $\epsilon:Q_hL\to K(F)Q_h$ exhibit $L$ as a left-derived functor for quasi-isomorphisms. For every pair of complexes $P,N$, supply an isomorphism $\varphi_{P,N}:F\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes FN)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Assume $\varphi$ is natural in both complexes and $\epsilon_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)};Q(\varphi_{P,N})$ is invertible for every K-flat pair $P,N$ [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Then there exists a natural isomorphism of bifunctors $\mu:(A,B)\mapsto LA\otimes LB\cong(A,B)\mapsto L(A\otimes B)$ such that $\mu_{QP,QN};L(\mu_Q(P,N));\epsilon_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)};Q(\varphi_{P,N})=(\epsilon_P\otimes\epsilon_N);\mu_Q(FP,FN)$ for every K-flat pair. No associativity, unit comparison, or unit law is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the natural tensor comparison on K-flat cochain representatives, with its component equation. This is only the model-class argument, before localization.
